La Brava.name: La Brava
La Brava.basicInfo:
La Brava, Gentle Criminal's devoted partner, who runs the camera and keyboard behind his videos. A short woman; raspberry-pink curling pigtails, pink eyes over dark circles; an indigo blouse with a white bow, white gloves, puffed pinstriped trousers.
Speaking Style: Rapid, gushing praise of Gentle; tearful when he is in danger.
Combat Role: Not a fighter: she films, hacks and boosts Gentle with her Quirk.
Under Pressure: Throws everything behind Gentle, her own safety included.
La Brava.hiddenInfo:
Contradiction: Her worth hangs on Gentle's approval, yet her own skills carry their stunts. Motivation: Gentle's success and safety. Concealment: Her real name, Manami Aiba, and her skill as a hacker. Connections: Gentle Criminal (Danjuro Tobita), her partner and the man she loves. Canon voice & behavior: Films every flourish and cheers between takes. Thread: Whether her devotion sinks them or saves them.
QUIRK: Love. A declaration of love boosts the one she loves for a while, with a daily limit.
personality: Devoted: Commits every skill she has to Gentle and his dream.
Adoring: Calls every stunt Gentle's finest.
Dependent: Ties her worth to Gentle's approval.
Speaking style: Rapid praise and candid emotion.
abilities: Love: Declares her love to boost Gentle in a fight; not on demand.
Hacking: Networks and security cameras; real skill, not a Quirk, and it takes time.
Filming: Shoots and edits the videos and plans every getaway.
Fighting style: Stays back with camera and laptop; fights only by boosting Gentle.
La Brava.visualDescription: A woman of short stature with adult features, raspberry-pink hair in two tall, curling pigtails, large pink eyes with dark circles beneath them and pale skin. She wears an indigo long-sleeved blouse with a large white bow at the collar, white gloves and puffed pinstriped trousers, with a small camera on a strap around her neck. Eager, adoring expression.
